'''Kana Ueda''' (Japanese: '''植田佳奈''' ''Ueda Kana'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ueda was born on June 9, 1980, in {{wp|Ikoma, Nara}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and raised in {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}. As an adult, she attended Kobe College and graduated from its General Culture department. She later became a voice actress and eventually became well-known for a number of roles in anime series. Ueda voiced a [[character of the day]], [[Luna]], during {{aniseries|RS}}. She then voiced her best-known role in {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[Mistralton City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Skyla]]. Ueda is affiliated with the voice talent management firm {{wp|I'm Enterprise}}.
